newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stores' shares hit by Paris bomb fears.
newsitem.headline: French stores' shares hit by Paris bomb fears.

text.p: Shares in major French stores groups and hotelier Accor fell heavily on Wednesday on fears that Tuesday's bomb at a central Paris railway station would scare people away and put off foreign tourists, brokers said.
At 1126 GMT, Galeries Lafayette shed 3.2 percent to 1,752 francs, BHV 2.62 percent to 480.1, Pinault- Printemps-Redoute 2.32 percent to 2,017, while Accor fell 2.07 percent to 661.
Profit-taking on Printemps probably exaggerated the fall, as the stock has risen strongly recently, they added.
In the Printemps group, sales through the La Redoute mail order catalogue could offset any drop in activity in its stores, another broker said.
